summary: Braskem S.A. and five Dutch finance affiliates filed a 6-K furnishing an Extrajudicial Restructuring Plan (Brazil’s out-of-court reorganization, equivalent to a US Chapter 11 plan) dated August 24, 2026. The debtors jointly filed under Brazilian law with signatory creditors’ adhesion, seeking consensual debt adjustment. Terms, ownership split, and consideration are not detailed in the excerpt. The board recommendation is not stated; restructuring advisors are unnamed. The filing indicates ongoing negotiations and court procedural steps. Watch for creditor support thresholds and potential plan confirmation timeline.
